*{for win,linux}Click the menu button [[Image:Fx89menuButton]], click {menu Help} and select {menu More Troubleshooting Information}.{/for}{for mac}From the {menu Help} menu, select {menu More Troubleshooting Information}.{/for} The '''Troubleshooting Information''' tab will open.
*Under the '''Application Basics''' section next to ''{for not linux}Profile Folder{/for}{for linux}Profile Directory{/for}'', click {button {for win}Open Folder{/for}{for mac}Show in Finder{/for}{for linux}Open Directory{/for}}. {for mac}A window will open that contains your profile folder.{/for}{for win}Your profile folder will open.{/for}{for linux}Your profile directory will open.{/for}
{note}'''Note:''' <!--  MSIX (Microsoft Store issue - see https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1731753#c3 --> If{for win10,win11} Firefox displays an error after clicking {button Open Folder} or if{/for} you are unable to open or use Firefox, follow the instructions in [[Profiles - Where Firefox stores your bookmarks, passwords and other user data#w_finding-your-profile-without-opening-firefox|Finding your profile without opening Firefox]].{/note}
